description: Series-branded fast-cut montage of small wins stitched together: commit lands, render passes, video posts, engagement arrives, agent picks it up. Models the 'Day N' buildinpublic format and Riley Brown's project-name brand series. High pace, high satisfying-completion density.
recommended_use: Recurring 'Day N' updates on Rally's progress. Best for compounding follower growth via series recognition. Each entry shows tangible progress beats stitched together; the series-banner ('Day N: ...') is the through-line.
reference_notes: Series-branded. Every video opens with 'Day N: ...' banner that holds 1.5-2s.
6-10 fast cuts, each 1.5-3 seconds. No single beat lingers.
Real captures only — terminal, github, vercel deploy, eval.py output, video player, engagement counters.
First-person voiceover narrates 'today I shipped X, Y, Z' over the cuts.
Static caption box per cut holding 1-2s with the win ('eval passed', 'merged', '5 likes').
Reference library row 27 (itsryan.ai 'Day 6: building your first ai'), row 28 (jun_yuh '7 day plan').
End with comment-CTA tied to the day's win, e.g. 'comment Day 1 if you watched the launch'.

camera: no slow pans or cinematic moves
texture: consistent series-banner ('Day N: title') in upper third
occasional smash cut with bold text overlay
composition_rules: Day N banner must appear in the first 1.5s and remain anchored in upper third.
Each cut must be 1.5-3s; longer holds break the montage rhythm.
Real UI fills the frame; no generated b-roll.
Caption box per cut summarizes the win in 3-7 words.
Final panel resolves the day with a meta-frame ('Day N: shipped X, Y, Z') and comment-CTA.

caption_treatment.style: static red-on-black per-cut captions; persistent yellow-on-black 'Day N' banner in upper third

default_routes.day_banner_open: real screen capture with Day N banner overlay (assembly drawtext)
default_routes.win_1: real screen capture (terminal, vercel, github) of the specific win
default_routes.win_2: real screen capture of next win
default_routes.win_3: real screen capture of next win
default_routes.win_4: real screen capture of next win
default_routes.day_summary_and_cta: static text card with Day N summary and comment-CTA

fallback_routes.screen_capture_failed_for_one_win: deterministic proof card from source data; never generated UI
fallback_routes.fewer_than_6_wins_for_the_day: consolidate or downgrade to dev_pov_screen_capture style
